text:
maya: Quick sync — authz cutover on Console is next Wed. Who owns telemetry and latency SLOs for the handoff? We need clear owners before cutover.
kevin: I can take the query-side metrics (query.total_latency, query.kv_cache_hit). but authz sidecar metrics look like sam's area.
sam: yep, runtime/authz owns authz.latency, authz.cache_hit. we should avoid double-counting in dashboards.
alex: idea: emit a single correlation_id per request early in the proxy and propagate through authz->query->ui. then dashboards can join by correlation_id. :thumbsup:
maya: agreed. also need to limit cardinality — we can't tag every route+user combo at 100%.
sam: propose sampled high-cardinality tags: sample 100% for new users (canary), 5% for production otherwise. store sample decision in req header (X-telemetry-sample).
kevin: concrete metrics plan: - add req_id tag - emit authz.latency (ms) with tags: sampled (true|false), auth_path - emit query.total_latency with same tags - emit authz.cache_hit counter
jess: small note: dashboards currently expect authz metrics under eng-platform namespace. let's not break existing panels. can we provide a Compatibility shim for 2 weeks?
maya: yes — rollout plan: 1) add req_id and sampling headers (no dashboard changes) 2) backfill authz metrics to new namespace + shim 3) enable canary sampling for 1000 sessions 4) measure p95/p99 for 48h 5) flip default sample to 5% then iterate.
kevin: ops question — how do we measure authz-induced tail? need histogram of authz latency and a derived metric authz_tail_pct where authz.latency > 300ms.
sam: we'll add a histogram bucket at 50/100/200/500/1000ms. dashboards can compute pctgt(300ms).
alex: code snippet for Go middleware to propagate req id and sample decision:
```
func InjectTelemetry(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
  return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request){
    id := r.Header.Get("X-Request-Id")
    if id=="" { id = uuid.New().String(); r.Header.Set("X-Request-Id", id) }
    sampled := decideSample(r) // returns "true"/"false"
    r.Header.Set("X-Telemetry-Sampled", sampled)
    ctx := metrics.WithTags(r.Context(), map[string]string{"req_id": id, "sampled": sampled})
    next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
  })
}
```
jess: +1. Also suggest a short-lived dashboard tab "authz-cutover" with read-only panels for SRE and platform PMs.
maya: permission question — RBAC events contain tenant ids. we must ensure we never log tenant ids in high-cardinality tags unless sampled. redact by default.
sam: agreed. default tag auth_tenant = "redacted" unless sampled=="true". store full tenant in encrypted event store for audits.
kevin: opsbot note: deploy-bot: rolling deploy scheduled for 2025-03-12 03:00 UTC. :calendar:
maya: thanks @deploy-bot. final ask: can eng-runtime and eng-platform owners add a short runbook for cutover rollback criteria? e.g., 10% increase in p95 for 15m => rollback.
alex: I can draft the rollback thresholds and post as PR to infra-runbooks.
jess: i'll create the dashboard and share links in #all-hands once ready.
maya: great. i'll collect owners and add to the cutover playbook. tagging @kevin @sam @alex for followups. :rocket:
+maya reaction :thumbsup:
